create or replace function public.guard_ta_assignment_immutables()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') then
    return new;
  end if;
  if new.student_id is distinct from old.student_id
     or new.interaction_id is distinct from old.interaction_id
     or new.title is distinct from old.title
     or new.content_html is distinct from old.content_html
     or new.asset_ids is distinct from old.asset_ids
     or new.pdf_url is distinct from old.pdf_url
     or new.response_schema is distinct from old.response_schema
     or new.answer_key_html is distinct from old.answer_key_html
     or new.assigned_by is distinct from old.assigned_by
     or new.assigned_at is distinct from old.assigned_at
     or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at then
    raise exception 'ta_assignments: assignment content is immutable for students';
  end if;
  if old.status = 'completed'
     and (
       new.status is distinct from old.status
       or new.response_data is distinct from old.response_data
       or new.response_saved_at is distinct from old.response_saved_at
       or new.completed_at is distinct from old.completed_at
     ) then
    raise exception 'ta_assignments: submitted work is locked';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_guided_drill_sets(q text, max_rows int DEFAULT 10)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id                    uuid,
  title                 text,
  description           text,
  question_type         text,
  reasoning_type        text,
  question_feature      text,
  guided_set_type       text,
  estimated_minutes     integer,
  difficulty_min        integer,
  difficulty_max        integer,
  question_count        integer,
  instructions_excerpt  text
)

AS $$

    hs.id,
    hs.title,
    hs.description,
    hs.question_type,
    hs.reasoning_type,
    hs.question_feature,
    hs.guided_set_type,
    hs.estimated_minutes,
    hs.difficulty_min,
    hs.difficulty_max,
    coalesce(array_length(hs.question_qids, 1), 0)::int AS question_count,
    left(coalesce(hs.instructions_markdown, ''), 400) AS instructions_excerpt
  FROM public.homework_sets hs
  WHERE hs.is_guided_set = true
    AND (
      q IS NULL OR q = '' OR
      hs.title ILIKE '%' || q || '%' OR
      hs.description ILIKE '%' || q || '%' OR
      hs.question_type ILIKE '%' || q || '%' OR
      hs.reasoning_type ILIKE '%' || q || '%' OR
      hs.question_feature ILIKE '%' || q || '%' OR
      hs.guided_set_type ILIKE '%' || q || '%'
    )
  ORDER BY hs.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT max_rows;
$$

BEGIN
  IF public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RETURN NEW;

  IF NEW.activity_id       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.activity_id       OR
     NEW.student_id        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.student_id        OR
     NEW.title             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.title             OR
     NEW.subtitle          IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subtitle          OR
     NEW.instructions      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.instructions      OR
     NEW.item_format       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.item_format       OR
     NEW.items             IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.items             OR
     NEW.assigned_by       IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.assigned_by       OR
     NEW.class_id          IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.class_id          OR
     NEW.mode              IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mode              OR
     NEW.source_section    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_section    OR
     NEW.time_goal_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.time_goal_minutes OR
     NEW.created_at        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'activity_assignments: snapshot columns are immutable for non-admin users';
  END IF;

create or replace function public.memory_recall(
  p_namespace_ids   uuid[],
  p_query           text,
  p_query_embedding vector(3072) default null,
  p_kinds           public.memory_kind[] default array['semantic','procedural']::public.memory_kind[],
  p_candidate_count int default 40
)
returns table (
  id uuid, namespace_id uuid, kind public.memory_kind, title text, content text,
  tags text[], structured jsonb, visibility public.memory_visibility,
  source_authority public.memory_source_authority, importance real, confidence real,
  use_count int, success_count int, pinned boolean, last_used_at timestamptz,
  claim_key text, strength real
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare v_ns uuid;
begin
  foreach v_ns in array p_namespace_ids loop          -- access gate IN SQL, per namespace
    if not public.can_access_memory_namespace(v_ns, 'read') then
      raise exception 'recall denied for namespace %', v_ns using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end loop;

  return query
  with base as (
    select m.* from public.memory_items m
    where m.namespace_id = any(p_namespace_ids)
      and m.status = 'active'
      and m.kind = any(p_kinds)
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
  ),
  vec as (
    select b.id, row_number() over (order by b.embedding <=> p_query_embedding) r
    from base b
    where p_query_embedding is not null and b.embedding is not null
    order by b.embedding <=> p_query_embedding
    limit p_candidate_count
  ),
  fts as (
    select b.id, row_number() over (
      order by ts_rank(
        to_tsvector('english', coalesce(b.title,'')||' '||coalesce(b.content,'')),
        websearch_to_tsquery('english', p_query)
      ) desc) r
    from base b
    where coalesce(btrim(p_query),'') <> ''
      and to_tsvector('english', coalesce(b.title,'')||' '||coalesce(b.content,''))
          @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', p_query)
    limit p_candidate_count
  )
  select b.id, b.namespace_id, b.kind, b.title, b.content, b.tags, b.structured, b.visibility,
         b.source_authority, b.importance, b.confidence, b.use_count, b.success_count,
         b.pinned, b.last_used_at, b.claim_key,
         ( -- reciprocal-rank fusion (k=60) + pin + light signal boosts
           1.0/(60 + coalesce(v.r, 9999)) + 1.0/(60 + coalesce(f.r, 9999))
           + (case when b.pinned then 1.0 else 0 end)
           + 0.15 * b.importance
           + 0.10 * (b.success_count::real / greatest(1, b.use_count))
           + 0.10 * exp(-extract(epoch from (now() - coalesce(b.last_used_at, b.created_at))) / 1209600.0)
         )::real as strength
  from base b
  left join vec v on v.id = b.id
  left join fts f on f.id = b.id
  where b.pinned or v.id is not null or f.id is not null
  order by b.pinned desc, strength desc
  limit p_candidate_count;
end;
$$

retrieve_lsat_knowledge.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retrieve_lsat_knowledge(
  query_text text,
  query_embedding vector(3072),
  entity_type text DEFAULT NULL,
  entity_key text DEFAULT NULL,
  section_key text DEFAULT NULL,
  authority_filter text DEFAULT NULL,
  source_version_filter text DEFAULT NULL,
  match_count integer DEFAULT 8,
  kinds text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['lsat_methodology']::text[],
  rrf_k integer DEFAULT 60
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  record_id text,
  kind text,
  source_id text,
  chunk_index integer,
  title text,
  subtitle text,
  body text,
  url text,
  metadata jsonb,
  heading_path jsonb,
  fts_rank double precision,
  vector_similarity double precision,
  score double precision
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM public.lsatu_content_index c
    JOIN public.lsat_knowledge_sources s
      ON s.slug    = c.metadata->>'source_slug'
     AND s.version = c.metadata->>'source_version'
     AND s.status  = 'active'
    WHERE (kinds IS NULL OR c.kind = ANY(kinds))
      AND (entity_type IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'entity_type' = entity_type)
      AND (entity_key  IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'entity_key'  = entity_key)
      AND (section_key IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'section_key' = section_key)
      AND (authority_filter IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'authority' = authority_filter)
      -- source_version_filter is accepted for backwards-compat but is
      -- intersected with the active-version join above, so it can only ever
      -- narrow to the active version.
      AND (source_version_filter IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'source_version' = source_version_filter)
  ),
  fts AS (
    SELECT b.id,
           ts_rank(
             to_tsvector('english',
               coalesce(b.title,'')||' '||coalesce(b.subtitle,'')||' '||coalesce(b.body,'')),
             websearch_to_tsquery('english', coalesce(query_text,''))
           )::float AS rank
    FROM base b
    WHERE query_text IS NOT NULL
      AND length(btrim(query_text)) > 0
      AND to_tsvector('english',
            coalesce(b.title,'')||' '||coalesce(b.subtitle,'')||' '||coalesce(b.body,''))
          @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', query_text)
    ORDER BY rank DESC
    LIMIT greatest(match_count * 4, 40)
  ),
  vec AS (
    SELECT b.id,
           1 - (b.embedding <=> query_embedding)::float AS similarity
    FROM base b
    WHERE query_embedding IS NOT NULL
      AND b.embedding IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY b.embedding <=> query_embedding
    LIMIT greatest(match_count * 4, 40)
  ),
  fts_ranked AS (
    SELECT id, rank, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY rank DESC) AS rn FROM fts
  ),
  vec_ranked AS (
    SELECT id, similarity, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY similarity DESC) AS rn FROM vec
  ),
  fused AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(f.id, v.id) AS id,
      coalesce(f.rank, 0)::float AS fts_rank,
      coalesce(v.similarity, 0)::float AS vector_similarity,
      (
        coalesce(1.0 / (rrf_k + f.rn), 0)
      + coalesce(1.0 / (rrf_k + v.rn), 0)
      )::float AS score
    FROM fts_ranked f
    FULL OUTER JOIN vec_ranked v ON v.id = f.id
  )
  SELECT
    b.id,
    (b.source_id || '/chunk-' || lpad(b.chunk_index::text, 2, '0')) AS record_id,
    b.kind,
    b.source_id,
    b.chunk_index,
    b.title,
    b.subtitle,
    b.body,
    b.url,
    b.metadata,
    coalesce(b.metadata->'heading_path', '[]'::jsonb) AS heading_path,
    fused.fts_rank,
    fused.vector_similarity,
    fused.score
  FROM fused
  JOIN base b ON b.id = fused.id
  ORDER BY fused.score DESC, b.chunk_index ASC
  LIMIT greatest(1, least(match_count, 25));
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_student_booking(_auth_user_id uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _pass public.booking_passes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.booking_passes
  SET status = 'expired'
  WHERE student_id = _auth_user_id AND status = 'active'
    AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now();

  UPDATE public.booking_passes
  SET status = 'exhausted'
  WHERE student_id = _auth_user_id AND status = 'active'
    AND used_credits >= total_credits;

  SELECT * INTO _pass
  FROM public.booking_passes
  WHERE student_id = _auth_user_id
  ORDER BY
    CASE status WHEN 'active' THEN 0 WHEN 'paused' THEN 1 WHEN 'exhausted' THEN 2
      WHEN 'expired' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pass', CASE WHEN _pass.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
      'status', _pass.status,
      'total_credits', _pass.total_credits,
      'used_credits', _pass.used_credits,
      'credits_remaining', GREATEST(0, _pass.total_credits - _pass.used_credits),
      'session_length_minutes', _pass.session_length_minutes,
      'expires_at', _pass.expires_at
    ) END,
    'redemptions', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.start_at)
      FROM (
        SELECT red.id, red.start_at, red.end_at, red.status, red.meet_url,
          red.reschedule_count, red.google_event_id,
          red.calendar_status, red.submission_status,
          (red.status = 'booked' AND red.start_at > now() AND red.reschedule_count < 1) AS can_reschedule
        FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions red
        JOIN public.booking_passes bp ON bp.id = red.booking_pass_id
        WHERE bp.student_id = _auth_user_id
      ) r
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_booking_availability()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _cfg public.booking_availability_config%ROWTYPE;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _cfg FROM public.booking_availability_config WHERE id = 1;
  _result := jsonb_build_object(
    'timezone', COALESCE(_cfg.timezone, 'America/Toronto'),
    'buffer_minutes', COALESCE(_cfg.buffer_minutes, 10),
    'minimum_notice_minutes', COALESCE(_cfg.minimum_notice_minutes, 1440),
    'window_days', COALESCE(_cfg.window_days, 8),
    'ranges', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.day_of_week, r.start_time)
      FROM (
        SELECT day_of_week,
               to_char(start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS start_time,
               to_char(end_time,   'HH24:MI') AS end_time
        FROM public.booking_availability
      ) r
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'overrides', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.date, o.start_time)
      FROM (
        SELECT to_char(date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,
               to_char(start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS start_time,
               to_char(end_time,   'HH24:MI') AS end_time
        FROM public.booking_availability_overrides
        WHERE date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(_cfg.timezone, 'America/Toronto'))::date - 1
      ) o
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

  _pass public.booking_passes%ROWTYPE;
  _did_refund boolean := false;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _redemption
  FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
  WHERE id = _redemption_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redemption_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0404';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO _pass
  FROM public.booking_passes
  WHERE id = _redemption.booking_pass_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF _redemption.status = 'cancelled' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'redemption', to_jsonb(_redemption),
      'pass', to_jsonb(_pass),
      'was_existing', true,
      'refunded', _redemption.credit_refunded
    );
  END IF;

  IF _redemption.status <> 'booked' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redemption_not_booked:%', _redemption.status USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(_refund, true) AND NOT _redemption.credit_refunded AND _pass.used_credits > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.booking_passes
    SET used_credits = used_credits - 1,
        status = CASE
          WHEN status = 'exhausted'
            AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) THEN 'active'
          ELSE status
        END
    WHERE id = _pass.id
    RETURNING * INTO _pass;
    _did_refund := true;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.booking_pass_redemptions
  SET status = 'cancelled',
      cancelled_at = COALESCE(cancelled_at, now()),
      cancelled_by = COALESCE(cancelled_by, _actor_id),
      credit_refunded = credit_refunded OR _did_refund,
      -- Even an ID-less row may have a committed Google event whose database
      -- persistence failed. The reconciler searches by redemption stamp before
      -- deciding there is nothing to delete.
      calendar_action = 'delete',
      calendar_status = 'pending',
      calendar_error = NULL,
      calendar_lease_until = NULL,
      needs_gcal_sync = true,
      gcal_state = 'pending',
      gcal_error = NULL
  WHERE id = _redemption.id
  RETURNING * INTO _redemption;

  UPDATE public.schedule_events
  SET status = 'cancelled', deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, now())
  WHERE id = _redemption.schedule_event_id
     OR (_redemption.google_event_id IS NOT NULL AND google_event_id = _redemption.google_event_id);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'redemption', to_jsonb(_redemption),
    'pass', to_jsonb(_pass),
    'was_existing', false,
    'refunded', _did_refund
  );
END;
$$

manage_booking_pass.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.manage_booking_pass(
  _pass_id uuid,
  _action text,
  _credits int DEFAULT NULL,
  _session_length_minutes int DEFAULT NULL,
  _expires_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
  _clear_expiry boolean DEFAULT false
) RETURNS public.booking_passes
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _pass public.booking_passes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _pass FROM public.booking_passes WHERE id = _pass_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'pass_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0404';
  END IF;

  IF _action = 'add_credits' THEN
    IF _credits IS NULL OR _credits < 1 OR _credits > 50 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.booking_passes
    SET total_credits = total_credits + _credits,
        status = CASE
          WHEN status = 'exhausted' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) THEN 'active'
          ELSE status
        END
    WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSIF _action IN ('set_remaining', 'set_terms_and_remaining') THEN
    IF _credits IS NULL OR _credits < 0 OR _credits > 50 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
    END IF;
    IF _pass.used_credits = 0 AND _credits = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_credits' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
    END IF;
    IF _action = 'set_terms_and_remaining'
      AND _session_length_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND (_session_length_minutes < 15 OR _session_length_minutes > 480) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_session_length' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.booking_passes
    SET total_credits = used_credits + _credits,
        session_length_minutes = CASE
          WHEN _action = 'set_terms_and_remaining' THEN COALESCE(_session_length_minutes, session_length_minutes)
          ELSE session_length_minutes
        END,
        expires_at = CASE
          WHEN _action = 'set_terms_and_remaining' AND _clear_expiry THEN NULL
          WHEN _action = 'set_terms_and_remaining' THEN COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at)
          ELSE expires_at
        END,
        status = CASE
          WHEN status IN ('revoked', 'paused') THEN status
          WHEN _action = 'set_terms_and_remaining' AND NOT _clear_expiry
            AND COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at) <= now() THEN 'expired'
          WHEN _action <> 'set_terms_and_remaining' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired'
          WHEN _credits = 0 THEN 'exhausted'
          ELSE 'active'
        END
    WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSIF _action = 'pause' THEN
    IF _pass.status = 'revoked' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pass_revoked' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.booking_passes SET status = 'paused' WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSIF _action = 'resume' THEN
    IF _pass.status <> 'paused' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'pass_not_paused' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400'; END IF;
    UPDATE public.booking_passes
    SET status = CASE
      WHEN expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired'
      WHEN used_credits >= total_credits THEN 'exhausted'
      ELSE 'active'
    END
    WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSIF _action = 'update_terms' THEN
    IF _session_length_minutes IS NOT NULL
      AND (_session_length_minutes < 15 OR _session_length_minutes > 480) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_session_length' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.booking_passes
    SET session_length_minutes = COALESCE(_session_length_minutes, session_length_minutes),
        expires_at = CASE WHEN _clear_expiry THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at) END,
        status = CASE
          WHEN status IN ('revoked', 'paused') THEN status
          WHEN NOT _clear_expiry AND COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(_expires_at, expires_at) <= now() THEN 'expired'
          WHEN used_credits >= total_credits THEN 'exhausted'
          ELSE 'active'
        END
    WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSIF _action = 'revoke' THEN
    UPDATE public.booking_passes SET status = 'revoked' WHERE id = _pass_id RETURNING * INTO _pass;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_action' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
  END IF;

  RETURN _pass;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_booking_calendar_actions(
  _limit int DEFAULT 25,
  _lease_seconds int DEFAULT 120
) RETURNS SETOF public.booking_pass_redemptions
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
    WHERE calendar_action <> 'none'
      AND calendar_status IN ('pending', 'processing')
      AND (calendar_lease_until IS NULL OR calendar_lease_until < now())
    ORDER BY updated_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(_limit, 1), 100)
  )
  UPDATE public.booking_pass_redemptions r
  SET calendar_status = 'processing',
      calendar_attempts = calendar_attempts + 1,
      calendar_lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(GREATEST(_lease_seconds, 30), 600))
  FROM candidates c
  WHERE r.id = c.id
  RETURNING r.*;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_booking_calendar_event(
  _redemption_id uuid,
  _google_event_id text,
  _start_at timestamptz,
  _end_at timestamptz,
  _deleted boolean DEFAULT false,
  _meet_url text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _red public.booking_pass_redemptions%ROWTYPE;
  _conflict uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _red FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
  WHERE id = _redemption_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'redemption_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0404';
  END IF;

  IF _deleted THEN
    INSERT INTO public.booking_calendar_alerts (redemption_id, alert_type, details)
    VALUES (_redemption_id, 'deleted', jsonb_build_object('google_event_id', _google_event_id))
    ON CONFLICT (redemption_id, alert_type) WHERE status = 'open'
    DO UPDATE SET details = EXCLUDED.details;

    UPDATE public.booking_pass_redemptions
    SET calendar_action = 'none', calendar_status = 'failed',
        calendar_error = 'google_event_deleted_requires_adjudication',
        calendar_lease_until = NULL,
        gcal_state = 'failed', gcal_error = 'google_event_deleted_requires_adjudication',
        needs_gcal_sync = false
    WHERE id = _redemption_id RETURNING * INTO _red;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('outcome', 'deleted_alert', 'redemption', to_jsonb(_red));
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO _conflict
  FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
  WHERE id <> _redemption_id AND status = 'booked'
    AND start_at < _end_at AND end_at > _start_at
  LIMIT 1;

  IF _conflict IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.booking_calendar_alerts (redemption_id, alert_type, details)
    VALUES (_redemption_id, 'move_conflict', jsonb_build_object(
      'google_event_id', _google_event_id,
      'conflicting_redemption_id', _conflict,
      'requested_start_at', _start_at,
      'requested_end_at', _end_at
    ))
    ON CONFLICT (redemption_id, alert_type) WHERE status = 'open'
    DO UPDATE SET details = EXCLUDED.details;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('outcome', 'move_conflict', 'conflicting_redemption_id', _conflict);
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.booking_pass_redemptions
  SET start_at = _start_at, end_at = _end_at,
      google_event_id = COALESCE(_google_event_id, google_event_id),
      meet_url = COALESCE(_meet_url, meet_url),
      calendar_action = 'none', calendar_status = 'synced',
      calendar_error = NULL, calendar_lease_until = NULL,
      calendar_last_synced_at = now(), needs_gcal_sync = false,
      gcal_state = 'synced', gcal_error = NULL
  WHERE id = _redemption_id RETURNING * INTO _red;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('outcome', 'updated', 'redemption', to_jsonb(_red));
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.take_abandoned_booking_uploads(
  _older_than interval DEFAULT interval '24 hours',
  _limit int DEFAULT 250
) RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, storage_path text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH doomed AS (
    SELECT e.id
    FROM public.external_work_uploads e
    WHERE e.redemption_id IS NULL
      AND e.booking_pass_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.created_at < now() - _older_than
      AND (e.cleanup_claimed_at IS NULL OR e.cleanup_claimed_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
    ORDER BY e.created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(_limit, 1), 1000)
  )
  UPDATE public.external_work_uploads e
  SET cleanup_claimed_at = now()
  FROM doomed d
  WHERE e.id = d.id
  RETURNING e.id, e.storage_path;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_booking_health()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
  WITH pending AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int AS total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')::int AS over_5m,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE updated_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')::int AS over_15m,
      min(updated_at) AS oldest_at
    FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
    WHERE calendar_action <> 'none' AND calendar_status IN ('pending', 'processing')
  ), failed AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions WHERE calendar_status = 'failed') AS total,
      COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'redemption_id', f.id, 'calendar_action', f.calendar_action,
        'attempts', f.calendar_attempts, 'error', f.calendar_error
      ) ORDER BY f.updated_at) FROM (
        SELECT * FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
        WHERE calendar_status = 'failed' ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 25
      ) f), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
  ), alerts AS (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open')::int AS open_total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND alert_type = 'duplicate_event')::int AS duplicate_events,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND alert_type = 'double_booking')::int AS native_double_bookings,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND alert_type = 'refund_attention')::int AS refund_attention,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND alert_type IN ('deleted', 'move_conflict'))::int AS mismatches,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open' AND alert_type = 'persistence_failure')::int AS repair_items
    FROM public.booking_calendar_alerts
  ), uploads AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int AS staged_over_1h
    FROM public.external_work_uploads
    WHERE redemption_id IS NULL AND booking_pass_id IS NOT NULL
      AND created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
  ), sync AS (
    SELECT last_synced_at, last_attempt_at, sync_token_updated_at,
      extract(epoch FROM now() - last_synced_at)::int AS last_success_age_seconds,
      extract(epoch FROM now() - sync_token_updated_at)::int AS token_age_seconds
    FROM public.gcal_sync_state WHERE id = 1
  ), counts AS (
    SELECT
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked' AND google_event_id IS NULL)::int AS missing_google_event_ids,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked' AND calendar_status = 'synced' AND meet_url IS NULL)::int AS synced_missing_meet_urls,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE submission_status = 'failed')::int AS failed_submissions
    FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions
  ), single_counts AS (
    SELECT
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refund_pending')::int AS refund_pending,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refund_failed')::int AS refund_failed,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'checkout_open' AND stripe_expires_at < now())::int AS checkout_past_expiry,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('expired', 'abandoned', 'refund_pending', 'refunded', 'refund_failed', 'cancelled')
        AND gcal_event_id IS NOT NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.single_session_outbox o
          WHERE o.booking_id = single_session_bookings.id AND o.action = 'gcal_delete'
            AND o.state IN ('pending', 'leased', 'succeeded')))::int AS orphan_tentative_events
    FROM public.single_session_bookings
  ), outbox AS (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed')::int AS failed,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'superseded')::int AS superseded,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'leased' AND lease_until < now())::int AS stale_leases
    FROM public.single_session_outbox
  ), workers AS (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.last_success_at IS NULL OR h.last_success_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')::int AS stale
    FROM (VALUES ('single-session-sweeper'), ('single-session-outbox'), ('gcal-reconciler')) expected(worker_name)
    LEFT JOIN public.booking_worker_heartbeats h USING (worker_name)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'generated_at', now(),
    'overall_status', CASE
      WHEN single_counts.refund_failed > 0 OR outbox.failed > 0 OR workers.stale > 0
        OR failed.total > 0 OR pending.over_15m > 0 OR alerts.mismatches > 0
        OR alerts.native_double_bookings > 0 OR alerts.refund_attention > 0 THEN 'red'
      WHEN single_counts.refund_pending > 0 OR single_counts.checkout_past_expiry > 0
        OR single_counts.orphan_tentative_events > 0 OR pending.total > 0
        OR uploads.staged_over_1h > 0 OR counts.synced_missing_meet_urls > 0
        OR alerts.repair_items > 0 THEN 'amber'
      ELSE 'green' END,
    'pending_calendar_actions', to_jsonb(pending),
    'failed_calendar_actions', jsonb_build_object('total', failed.total, 'items', failed.items),
    'missing_google_event_ids', counts.missing_google_event_ids,
    'synced_missing_meet_urls', counts.synced_missing_meet_urls,
    'failed_submissions', counts.failed_submissions,
    'staged_uploads_over_1h', uploads.staged_over_1h,
    'calendar_sync', to_jsonb(sync),
    'alerts', to_jsonb(alerts),
    'single_session', to_jsonb(single_counts),
    'single_session_outbox', to_jsonb(outbox),
    'workers', to_jsonb(workers)
  ) FROM pending, failed, alerts, uploads, sync, counts, single_counts, outbox, workers;
$$

create or replace function public.mcp_find_students(p_query text, p_limit integer default 10)
returns table(student_id uuid, display_name text, email text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to 'public', 'auth'
as $function$
begin
  perform public.mcp_require_admin();
  if length(trim(coalesce(p_query, ''))) < 2 then
    raise exception 'student query must contain at least two characters';
  end if;

  return query
  select p.class_id::uuid, p.display_name, u.email::text
  from public.profiles p
  join auth.users u on u.id::text = p.class_id
  where not exists (
    select 1 from public.user_roles r
    where r.user_id::text = p.class_id and r.role = 'admin'
  )
    and (
      coalesce(p.display_name, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_query) || '%'
      or coalesce(u.email, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_query) || '%'
    )
  order by
    case when lower(coalesce(p.display_name, '')) = lower(trim(p_query)) then 0 else 1 end,
    p.display_name nulls last,
    u.email
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 10), 25));
end;
$function$

create or replace function public.mcp_get_or_create_admin_student_conversation(

)
returns uuid

set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  conv_id uuid;
begin
  select cp1.conversation_id into conv_id
  from public.conversation_participants cp1
  join public.conversation_participants cp2
    on cp1.conversation_id = cp2.conversation_id
  where cp1.user_id = p_admin_id
    and cp2.user_id = p_student_id
  limit 1;

  insert into public.conversations (subject, created_by, last_message_at)
  values (null, p_admin_id, now())
  returning id into conv_id;

  insert into public.conversation_participants
    (conversation_id, user_id, last_read_at)
  values
    (conv_id, p_admin_id, now()),
    (conv_id, p_student_id, null);

  return conv_id;
end;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_signup(p_notification_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_subject text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an admin can approve a signup.';
  END IF;

  SELECT subject_class_id INTO v_subject
  FROM public.notifications
  WHERE id = p_notification_id
    AND user_id = auth.uid()
    AND type = 'signup';

  IF v_subject IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No signup notification % for this admin.', p_notification_id;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.profiles SET
    has_classroom_access = true,
    has_practice_access  = true,
    has_drill_access     = true,
    has_bootcamp_access  = true,
    has_journal_access   = true,
    has_waj_access       = true,
    has_chat_access      = true,
    has_schedule_access  = true,
    has_activity_access  = true
  WHERE class_id = v_subject;

  UPDATE public.notifications
  SET status = 'approved', read = true
  WHERE id = p_notification_id;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.single_session_slot_lock_key(_start_at timestamptz)
RETURNS bigint
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT hashtextextended(
    'single-session-slot-day:' || ((_start_at AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(
      (SELECT timezone FROM public.booking_availability_config WHERE id = 1),
      'America/Toronto'
    ))::date)::text,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_single_session_outbox(
  _booking_id uuid,
  _action text,
  _recipient text,
  _state text,
  _precondition_status text,
  _precondition_lifecycle_version integer,
  _payload_ciphertext text DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS public.single_session_outbox
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _job public.single_session_outbox%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.single_session_outbox (
    booking_id, action, recipient, state, idempotency_key,
    precondition_status, precondition_lifecycle_version, payload_ciphertext
  ) VALUES (
    _booking_id, _action, COALESCE(NULLIF(_recipient, ''), 'system'), _state,
    _booking_id::text || ':' || _action || ':' || COALESCE(NULLIF(_recipient, ''), 'system'),
    _precondition_status, _precondition_lifecycle_version, _payload_ciphertext
  )
  ON CONFLICT (booking_id, action, recipient) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING * INTO _job;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    SELECT * INTO _job FROM public.single_session_outbox
    WHERE booking_id = _booking_id AND action = _action
      AND recipient = COALESCE(NULLIF(_recipient, ''), 'system');
  END IF;
  RETURN _job;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_single_session_outbox(
  _worker_id text,
  _actions text[] DEFAULT NULL,
  _limit integer DEFAULT 20,
  _lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120
) RETURNS SETOF public.single_session_outbox
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(trim(_worker_id), '') IS NULL OR _limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
     OR _lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 900 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_lease_request' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.single_session_outbox o SET
    state = 'superseded', lease_worker_id = NULL, lease_token = NULL,
    lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now(),
    last_error = COALESCE(o.last_error, 'lifecycle precondition no longer holds')
  FROM public.single_session_bookings b
  WHERE b.id = o.booking_id
    AND o.state IN ('pending', 'failed', 'leased')
    AND (o.state <> 'leased' OR o.lease_until <= now())
    AND (b.status <> o.precondition_status
      OR b.lifecycle_version <> o.precondition_lifecycle_version);

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT o.id
    FROM public.single_session_outbox o
    WHERE (o.state = 'pending'
        OR (o.state = 'leased' AND o.lease_until <= now()))
      AND o.next_retry_at <= now()
      AND o.attempts < o.max_attempts
      AND (_actions IS NULL OR o.action = ANY(_actions))
    ORDER BY o.next_retry_at, o.created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT _limit
  )
  UPDATE public.single_session_outbox o SET
    state = 'leased', attempts = o.attempts + 1,
    lease_worker_id = _worker_id, lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
    lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => _lease_seconds), updated_at = now()
  FROM candidates c WHERE o.id = c.id
  RETURNING o.*;
END;
$$

  _worker_id text,
  _limit integer DEFAULT 20,
  _lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120
) RETURNS SETOF public.single_session_bookings
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(trim(_worker_id), '') IS NULL OR _limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
     OR _lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 900 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_lease_request' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT b.id FROM public.single_session_bookings b
    WHERE (b.sweep_lease_until IS NULL OR b.sweep_lease_until <= now())
      AND (

        (b.checkout_request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
          AND b.stripe_checkout_session_id IS NULL
          AND (b.status NOT IN ('draft', 'checkout_open') OR b.draft_expires_at <= now()))
      )

    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT _limit
  )
  UPDATE public.single_session_bookings b SET
    sweep_worker_id = _worker_id, sweep_lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
    sweep_lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => _lease_seconds),

$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_booking_worker_heartbeat(
  _worker_name text,
  _phase text,
  _error text DEFAULT NULL,
  _metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
) RETURNS public.booking_worker_heartbeats
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE _heartbeat public.booking_worker_heartbeats%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF _phase NOT IN ('start', 'success', 'error') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_heartbeat_phase' USING ERRCODE = 'P0400';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.booking_worker_heartbeats (
    worker_name, last_start_at, last_success_at, last_error_at, last_error, metadata
  ) VALUES (
    _worker_name,
    CASE WHEN _phase = 'start' THEN now() END,
    CASE WHEN _phase = 'success' THEN now() END,
    CASE WHEN _phase = 'error' THEN now() END,
    CASE WHEN _phase = 'error' THEN left(_error, 4000) END,
    COALESCE(_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  ) ON CONFLICT (worker_name) DO UPDATE SET
    last_start_at = CASE WHEN _phase = 'start' THEN now() ELSE booking_worker_heartbeats.last_start_at END,
    last_success_at = CASE WHEN _phase = 'success' THEN now() ELSE booking_worker_heartbeats.last_success_at END,
    last_error_at = CASE WHEN _phase = 'error' THEN now() ELSE booking_worker_heartbeats.last_error_at END,
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN _phase = 'error' THEN left(_error, 4000)
      WHEN _phase = 'success' THEN NULL
      ELSE booking_worker_heartbeats.last_error END,
    metadata = COALESCE(_metadata, '{}'::jsonb), updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO _heartbeat;
  RETURN _heartbeat;
END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_single_session_pii(_now timestamptz DEFAULT now())
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
DECLARE _rows integer; _tokens integer; _outbox integer; _commerce integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.single_session_bookings SET
    name = NULL, email = NULL, notes = NULL, guests = '[]'::jsonb,
    stripe_checkout_url = NULL, ip_hash = NULL,
    booking_token_hash = 'purged:' || id::text,
    booking_token_expires_at = least(booking_token_expires_at, _now)
  WHERE status IN ('expired', 'abandoned')
    AND status_changed_at <= _now - interval '30 days'
    AND (name IS NOT NULL OR email IS NOT NULL OR notes IS NOT NULL OR ip_hash IS NOT NULL);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS _rows = ROW_COUNT;

  UPDATE public.single_session_bookings SET
    ip_hash = NULL,
    booking_token_hash = CASE WHEN status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'refund_failed')
      THEN 'purged:' || id::text ELSE booking_token_hash END,
    cancel_token_hash = CASE WHEN status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'refund_failed')
      THEN NULL ELSE cancel_token_hash END,
    cancel_token_expires_at = CASE WHEN status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'refund_failed')
      THEN NULL ELSE cancel_token_expires_at END
  WHERE status_changed_at <= _now - interval '30 days'
    AND (ip_hash IS NOT NULL OR (status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'refund_failed')
      AND (cancel_token_hash IS NOT NULL OR booking_token_hash NOT LIKE 'purged:%')));
  GET DIAGNOSTICS _tokens = ROW_COUNT;

  UPDATE public.single_session_outbox SET
    payload_ciphertext = NULL,
    sensitive_payload_purged_at = COALESCE(sensitive_payload_purged_at, _now),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE created_at <= _now - interval '30 days' AND payload_ciphertext IS NOT NULL;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS _outbox = ROW_COUNT;

  UPDATE public.booking_commerce_events SET payload = '{}'::jsonb
  WHERE single_session_booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND created_at <= _now - interval '30 days'
    AND payload <> '{}'::jsonb;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS _commerce = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'booking_pii_rows', _rows,
    'token_rows', _tokens,
    'outbox_payloads', _outbox,
    'commerce_payloads', _commerce
  );
END;
$$

create or replace function public.start_section_attempt(p_activity_id uuid)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $fn$
declare
  v_student uuid := auth.uid();
  v_activity public.activities%rowtype;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if v_student is null then
    raise exception 'not signed in';
  end if;

  select * into v_activity from public.activities where id = p_activity_id;
  if not found or v_activity.mode is distinct from 'section' then
    raise exception 'not a Read, Recall, Colour section';
  end if;

  -- An abandoned run is discarded rather than resumed (ADR 0023). The drill is
  -- one unbroken recording, so a half-run has no valid audio and nothing
  -- gradeable, and leaving it in the way would lock her out of the section she
  -- chose. A run that wrote rows is kept, as `abandoned`: the rows are what
  -- makes its recording recoverable, and the status is what keeps the grader
  -- and the sweeper off it. It used to be marked `completed` here, which is
  -- precisely the state both of them grade.
  update public.activity_assignments a
     set status = 'abandoned'
   where a.student_id = v_student and a.activity_id = p_activity_id
     and a.status in ('assigned', 'in_progress')
     and exists (select 1 from public.activity_item_responses r where r.assignment_id = a.id);

  delete from public.activity_assignments a
   where a.student_id = v_student and a.activity_id = p_activity_id
     and a.status in ('assigned', 'in_progress')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.activity_item_responses r where r.assignment_id = a.id);

  insert into public.activity_assignments
    (activity_id, student_id, class_id, title, subtitle, instructions, item_format,
     items, status, started_at, assigned_by, mode, time_goal_minutes, source_section)
  values
    (v_activity.id, v_student, v_activity.class_id, v_activity.title, v_activity.subtitle,
     v_activity.instructions, v_activity.item_format, v_activity.items, 'in_progress', now(),
     v_activity.created_by, v_activity.mode, v_activity.time_goal_minutes, v_activity.source_section)
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;
end;
$fn$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.booking_slot_is_clear(
  _start_at timestamptz,
  _end_at timestamptz,
  _buffer_before_minutes integer,
  _buffer_after_minutes integer,
  _ignore_single_session_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,
  _ignore_google_event_id text DEFAULT NULL,
  _ignore_schedule_event_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $$
  WITH probe AS (
    SELECT tstzrange(
      _start_at - make_interval(mins => GREATEST(_buffer_before_minutes, 0)),
      _end_at   + make_interval(mins => GREATEST(_buffer_after_minutes, 0)),
      '[)'
    ) AS r
  )
  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.single_session_bookings b, probe
    WHERE b.status IN ('draft', 'checkout_open', 'booked')
      AND (_ignore_single_session_id IS NULL OR b.id <> _ignore_single_session_id)
      AND tstzrange(b.start_at, b.end_at, '[)') && probe.r
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.booking_pass_redemptions x, probe
    WHERE x.status = 'booked'
      AND tstzrange(x.start_at, x.end_at, '[)') && probe.r
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.schedule_events se, probe
    WHERE se.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND se.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND COALESCE(se.transparency, 'opaque') <> 'transparent'
      AND (_ignore_google_event_id IS NULL OR se.google_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM _ignore_google_event_id)
      AND (_ignore_schedule_event_id IS NULL OR se.id <> _ignore_schedule_event_id)
      AND tstzrange(se.start_at, se.end_at, '[)') && probe.r
  );
$$
